findings: learner.overview.text: “紹 ... combines the thread-related 糸 with 召, identified as a sound element” describes the traditional construction, but does not explain that the simplified entry 绍 is related to 紹 as its standardized simplified form. Say explicitly that 绍 is the simplified form of 紹; the internal components belong to 紹.

history[1].text: The wording “An old-form account connects 綤 with 邵” obscures the documented disagreement: one account reads 邵, while another reads 卪. State both competing readings without implying that either establishes a graphic change sequence.
